conditions.clauseText: Not less than twelve months unless sooner discharged.

Ten infantry companies of at least64 men each; colonel/lieutenant-colonel/major, adjutant from lieutenants and sergeant-major from enlisted; each company captain/first lieutenant/two seconds/four sergeants/four corporals/two musicians.
Officers except staff appointed according to State law; staff by Confederate President.
Volunteers furnish uniform with commutation; Confederate arms/ammunition sent to Harpers Ferry or governor-designated point; transport and subsistence from departure.
Aid Virginia against stated common Southern enemy; answer whether and when; KY1/AR1/NC1/TN3 regiments.
Aid Virginia in repelling the stated common Southern enemy and opposing United States coercion of the Confederate States.
